name: Full Blooded Killah
notes: Known only from the RSPWF Top 200, the rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy newsgroup's own year-end poll. Placings and the poll's own federation tags, verbatim — 1999: #126, tagged EWWF, ICW. Also attested directly in this federation's own subject-bracket corpus: billed as its own World Champion in a September 1998 broadcast's own commentary, and separately soliciting help from fellow roleplayers for an in-character storyline counter-attack that June, in which he names himself the World Champion in EWWF.
caption: Billed as EWWF East's own World Champion across its 1998 broadcasts, later placing #126 in the RSPWF Top 200's 1999 poll.

tenures.source: the federation's own served broadcast (billed as World Champion in its own commentary), plus a June 1998 in-character recruitment thread naming this wrestler its own World Champion
